Both changes are in and the document validates. The main colour is now dark green (`#1B5E20`), and "Nos actions pour la jeunesse" appears in the portal menu.

- **Main colour:** I set `theme.colors.primary` and `theme.assistedModeColors.primary` to `#1B5E20`. The dark and high-contrast palettes still use `#1976D2`. In assisted mode the editor recalculates those palettes when a draft is saved, so they may change the next time someone saves in the UI. I haven't checked that in the UI.
- **Menu:** I added the page as a "Page libre" at the end of the menu, after Accueil and Catalogue de données. Its label is the page title.

During the edit I made a mistake. A partial write put copies of the header, footer, datasets and other root keys inside `theme`, and some keys went missing. I fixed it by rewriting `theme` with only the keys the schema defines. The final read-back shows the root keys and the theme keys where the schema expects them. The font CSS was retyped by hand, so I checked it by eye against the original, not byte for byte. The header, footer, dataset/application/reuse settings, social settings and topics are unchanged from the original.
